chapter: Zue Robertson, Bakke family and teachers
title: The Baquet family: George's younger brother
summary: The interviewer asks about the Baquet family; Barnes confirms a younger brother and recalls no other musicians in the family.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well I was going to ask some more about the Bakke family. We were talking yesterday about that Zule, Bakke too. He was a younger brother of George.
Yeah he was a younger brother of George Bakke.
Did their father play, do you remember, or anybody else in the family?
No I don't remember of anybody else outside of Oro and George.
You know where they learned, who their teacher was or anything?
